# A timeout is NOT a death, and is deliberately not resolved into one.
#
# A blocked call and a dead process look identical from one end of a socket. The honest
# record says which was observed - here the connection is still open, so the process is
# alive and the call has not come back yet.
CMD|1|hello|1
OBS|ack|1|hello
OBS|hello|1|77ab90ce|call,resolve,read,report
OBS|part|77ab90ce|target|console
OBS|part|77ab90ce|firmware|13.520.001
OBS|part|77ab90ce|probe|dev
OBS|done|1|ok||
CMD|2|resolve|libScePosix|read
OBS|ack|2|resolve
OBS|sym|libScePosix|read|present|shared
OBS|done|2|returned|0x8003ba10|
# A blocking read on a descriptor with nothing to give.
CMD|3|call|0x8003ba10|0x0|0x8100000|0x10
OBS|ack|3|call
# Written by the DRIVER after its budget elapsed. The socket is still open.
OBS|done|3|timeout||no result after 30s; connection still open
# The session is not usable while a command is outstanding - one command in flight at a
# time - so the driver closes and reconnects rather than pretending it can carry on.
